label: Krea 2 (hosted, Comfy Router)
_note: Krea 2 as a hosted model through Comfy Router (krea/krea-2, docs.comfy.org/development/comfy-router/models/krea/krea-2). The same model family as the local krea2 target, so a series' refs look alike made either way. No workflow: a take is one Router call (router_call in target.py). Text to image: Krea's image references are style references (image_style_references), not a subject to keep, so none are sent. Not yet tried against the live service (docs/PLAN.md, step 8).

capabilities._note: Hosted: Router only, and the provider decides what a seed means.

template._note: krea2's sizes. Krea 2 draws at 1K in a named aspect ratio: the nearest to each size is asked for, and the picture comes back at the provider's size for it.

recipe._note: Series refs are worded as krea2 words them (targets/image/common.py); keyframes by common.keyframe_prompt.

presets._note: No model files and no steps: the provider's.
